Initial release of Free Video Generator Cartoon — easily create animated cartoon videos from text or images in minutes.

- Free to use with 100 credits and no account required (simple anonymous token system).
- Cloud GPU-powered rendering; video ready in 1–2 minutes for most use cases.
- Automatic setup, clear status notifications throughout the workflow.
- Supports timeline editing: text, image, video, audio tracks, previews, and exporting.
- Handles session, error, and token management seamlessly; detailed workflow tips included.
